description: One published astrophotograph: preview and thumbnail blobs, optional original, and the astrometry that lets any viewer draw a catalog overlay. Derived from Astra's ManifestImage (viewer/src/types.ts). AT Protocol records carry no floating-point numbers, so every angle, scale and magnitude is an integer in a fixed sub-unit named by the property.

main.description: One image. The record key is a TID assigned at publish time; the publisher keeps the mapping from its own image id to the TID.

filename.description: Original file name (base name only, no directories). From ManifestImage.filename / images.filename.

summary.description: Author's caption or notes. From ManifestImage.summary / images.summary.

contentType.description: MIME type of the original capture, e.g. `image/jpeg` or `image/fits`. From ManifestImage.contentType / images.content_type.

createdAt.description: When the image was added to the library (RFC 3339 with time zone). From ManifestImage.createdAt / images.created_at.

capturedAt.description: When the exposure was taken, if known (FITS DATE-OBS). Distinct from createdAt.

favorite.description: Author flagged this image as a favorite. From ManifestImage.favorite / images.favorite.

catalogIds.description: Normalised catalog designations the image depicts, upper-case with spaces removed (`M42`, `NGC1976`). From ManifestImage.catalogIds; may be empty.

preview.description: Display-size rendition viewers show in the lightbox. Replaces ManifestImage.imagePath.

thumbnail.description: Small rendition for grids and cards. Replaces ManifestImage.thumbPath.

original.description: The full-resolution original (any MIME type, including image/fits). Optional: publishers may withhold it.

plateSolve.description: Astrometric solution for the preview's pixel grid, when the image has been plate-solved. From ManifestImage.plateSolve.

objects.description: Catalog objects within the field of view, with optional pixel positions for overlay. From ManifestImage.objects; may be empty.

equipment.description: Strong references to the gallery.astra.equipment records used for this capture.

plateSolve.description: A plate solve: where the image centre points, how big a pixel is, and how the frame is rotated. Mirrors Astra's PlateSolve with floats scaled to integers.

centerRaMicroDeg.description: Right ascension of the image centre, J2000, in millionths of a degree (degrees x 1e6, rounded). PlateSolve.centerRa 83.822 -> 83822000.

centerDecMicroDeg.description: Declination of the image centre, J2000, in millionths of a degree (degrees x 1e6, rounded). PlateSolve.centerDec -5.391 -> -5391000.

pixelScaleMilliArcsec.description: Angular size of one pixel in thousandths of an arcsecond (arcsec/px x 1000, rounded). PlateSolve.pixelScale 1.5 -> 1500.

rotationMilliDeg.description: Position angle of the frame (east of north) in thousandths of a degree (degrees x 1000, rounded). PlateSolve.rotation 0.5 -> 500.

widthMilliDeg.description: Field width in thousandths of a degree (degrees x 1000, rounded). PlateSolve.widthDeg 1.2 -> 1200.

heightMilliDeg.description: Field height in thousandths of a degree (degrees x 1000, rounded). PlateSolve.heightDeg 0.8 -> 800.

imageWidth.description: Width in pixels of the frame the solve and the object pixel positions refer to. PlateSolve.imageWidth (FITS NAXIS1).

imageHeight.description: Height in pixels of the solved frame. PlateSolve.imageHeight (FITS NAXIS2).

catalogObject.description: A catalog object in the field of view. Sky position is always present; pixel position is present when the image has been plate-solved. Mirrors Astra's CatalogObject with floats scaled to integers.

name.description: Catalog designation as displayed, e.g. `M 42` or `NGC 1976`. CatalogObject.name.

raMicroDeg.description: Right ascension, J2000, in millionths of a degree (degrees x 1e6, rounded). CatalogObject.ra.

decMicroDeg.description: Declination, J2000, in millionths of a degree (degrees x 1e6, rounded). CatalogObject.dec.

magnitudeMilli.description: Visual magnitude in thousandths (mag x 1000, rounded); negative for the brightest objects. CatalogObject.magnitude 4.0 -> 4000, -1.46 -> -1460.

sizeArcsecTenths.description: Apparent major-axis size in tenths of an arcsecond (arcsec x 10, i.e. arcmin x 600, rounded). CatalogObject.sizeArcmin 85.0 -> 51000.

pixelX.description: Horizontal pixel position of the object centre in the solved frame, rounded to the nearest pixel; may fall outside [0, imageWidth) for objects whose centre is just off-frame. CatalogObject.pixelX.

pixelY.description: Vertical pixel position of the object centre in the solved frame, rounded to the nearest pixel. CatalogObject.pixelY.

radiusPx.description: Overlay marker radius in pixels of the solved frame, rounded. CatalogObject.radiusPx.
